hooks.name: mobile-ui-guard
hooks.description: When UI files change, remind the agent of the hard mobile UI rules from steering/product.md.

action.prompt: A UI file was just saved. Check the change against the Ghost Tide mobile rules: landscape 914x411 reference, >=24px safe margin (respect env(safe-area-inset-*)), touch targets >=44px, text >=12px, and no keyboard or mouse prompts. If anything violates a rule, fix it and explain the fix.
